statement: Published Fuma pages use semantic HTML and compact CSS without the editor interface.
Unpublished edits remain private until an author explicitly publishes them.
Fuma combines visual building, content, media, forms and publishing in one product workflow.
Form submissions are retained in site-owned data tables rather than a required third-party form embed.
Fuma’s configured launch defaults are en-KE, Africa/Nairobi and KES; prices appear only when approved pricing authority is available.
